# Shared Live Source Map

<!-- Generated by tools/render_source_registry_docs.py from docs/skills/shared/references/live-source-registry.yaml -->

Use these shared live-source roles when researching the current Pokemon Champions meta or making current-field team recommendations. Official sources define legality, roster, calendar, and results; community sources describe the field inside that legal format; event sources verify standings; editorial sources add context.

Lock official regulation and roster truth first. Then use tournament_meta and broader_meta for the current field. Use supporting_sets only after the core stack is grounded. Use event_standings for results and team lists. Use editorial_context only for narrative, never for prevalence. A current-field recommendation needs the minimum meta stack; a team-building recommendation also needs the official roster.

## Official Sources

### Regulation Set M-C

Role: `official_regulation`
Kind: `official`
Canonical URL: https://news.pokemon-home.com/en/page/816.html
Freshness: re-check within 30 days; Re-check live before present-tense rules, legality, mechanics, or item claims.
Regulation ID: `regulation-m-c`
Temporal status: `current`
Active window: `2026-09-09T02:00:00Z` through `2026-12-02T01:59:00Z`
Required evidence fields: `source_id`, `source_url`, `fetched_at`, `format_window`, `active_mechanics`, `claim_type`

Use for:

- active regulation dates
- active mechanics
- held item rules
- timers

Do not use for:

- tournament usage claims
- prevalence claims about specific teams or cores
- set tendency claims

Counts toward the recommended minimum live stack.

Fallback if unavailable:

- Use the latest official Pokemon HOME Champions regulation article and label the swap explicitly.
- If no current official rules source is available, do not make present-tense legality or mechanics claims.

## Community Meta Sources

### infovgc

Role: `tournament_meta`
Kind: `community`
Canonical URL: https://infovgc.com/meta
Freshness: re-check within 1 days; Re-check live before tournament usage, win-rate, Top 8, or core claims; the site updates several times a day.
Required evidence fields: `source_id`, `source_url`, `fetched_at`, `claim_type`, `sample_scope`, `freshness_note`

Use for:

- tournament usage leaders with adjusted win rate and Top 8 index
- recent teams, trends, cores, and matchup pages for the active regulation
- official online tournament samples with team and game counts

Do not use for:

- legality or mechanics claims
- exact move or item legality claims

Counts toward the recommended minimum live stack.

Fallback if unavailable:

- Use Limitless or LabMaus and say which source replaced it.
- If no tournament-focused source is available, downgrade current-field conclusions to early-read language.

### LabMaus

Role: `tournament_meta`
Kind: `community`
Canonical URL: https://labmaus.net/
Freshness: re-check within 1 days; Re-check live before tournament, team, pairing, or trend claims; data changes with new events.
Required evidence fields: `source_id`, `source_url`, `fetched_at`, `claim_type`, `sample_scope`, `freshness_note`

Use for:

- tournament analysis, completed events, top teams, and team pairings
- 4-mon, 5-mon, and 6-mon compositions published by the top-teams endpoint

Do not use for:

- legality or mechanics claims
- exact move or item legality claims

Counts toward the recommended minimum live stack.

Fallback if unavailable:

- Use `python3 tools/fetch_labmaus.py` for LabMaus; do not use generic `curl -k`.
- If the fetcher is unavailable, use infovgc or Limitless and label the swap.

## Recommended Minimum Live Stack

For most current-meta questions and current-field team recommendations, use at least:

1. 1 official regulation source
2. 1 tournament-focused community source
3. 1 broader usage/community source

If those disagree materially, say so and keep the conclusion directional.

## Recommended Team-Build Legality Stack

For team-building recommendations, also use:

1. 1 current official roster source

The roster verifies species eligibility only. It does not verify items, moves, abilities, or mechanics.
